bugs.title: Local time uses the offset saved at sign-up
bugs.description: catalog.local_time adds utc_offset_minutes, the restaurant's UTC offset at sign-up (summer, UTC-4 in Toronto). Since the clocks went back on 1 November, Toronto is UTC-5, so the app believes it is an hour later than it is: the restaurant opens an hour early and closes an hour early.
mechanism_anchors: utc_offset_minutes is a fixed offset saved at sign-up
daylight saving time changed the real offset
the app thinks it is an hour later
the timezone column exists and is no longer used
bugs.fix: Convert with the restaurant's IANA time zone (ZoneInfo(restaurant['timezone'])).

grader_instructions: Task-only marketplace problem. 'where' is graded by line overlap (within 3 lines) with the planted lines; 'why' and 'fix' are multiple choice.

distractors.why.a: Dragon's hours (11:00-22:00) do not wrap past midnight
distractors.why.b: that would cost a minute, not an hour, and not explain early orders
distractors.why.d: the time is converted, just with the wrong offset
distractors.fix.b: right until the clocks change again in March, then wrong the other way
distractors.fix.c: daylight saving dates differ by year and by country, and some zones never change
distractors.fix.d: a fixed UTC opening time is wrong for half the year
